8. **Nathan Price to Prof. Smith**: Reminds Prof. Smith of the May 1st manuscript submission deadline for his book 'Daily Life in Ancient Thebes'.
9. **Melissa Carter to Casey**: Invites Casey to speak on a marketing panel at TechCon on May 15th about 'The Future of Digital Advertising in a Post-Cookie World,' covering travel expenses.
